data.title: Trump Tower
data.about:
Trump International Hotel by Dar Global introduces a new level of grandeur to the heart of Dubai. Featuring 2 and 3-bedroom apartments and an exclusive penthouse, it is the first and only Trump International Hotel and Tower in the Middle East. This architectural icon is developed by DarGlobal—an international real estate powerhouse specializing in ultra-luxury developments across the world’s most desirable cosmopolitan cities.

This tower is part of the prestigious Trump Organization global projects, bringing the brand’s signature hospitality and architectural excellence to Dubai’s skyline. From a rooftop pool to state-of-the-art wellness facilities, this is where world-class service meets timeless sophistication. Perfectly poised at the entrance to Downtown Dubai, the Trump Tower commands views of the city's cultural and commercial pulse, with direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road. From its location, major attractions such as Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Dubai Frame, and the Museum of the Future are just minutes away.

characteristics_module.title: A Trump-Branded Project in the UAE
characteristics_module.heading: UNIQUE SELLING POINTS
characteristics_module.description:
• Trump Branded Residences – Exquisite luxury homes featuring premium finishes, cutting-edge design, and signature Trump hospitality.
  • Trump Hotel – A world-class hospitality experience offering opulent accommodations, fine dining, and exceptional service.
  • Exclusive Members-Only Club – A prestigious private club providing VIPs with unparalleled luxury, privacy, and privileges.
  • High Investment Potential – A landmark project offering strong rental demand, capital appreciation, and premium returns.
  • Collaboration of Global Giants – Developed by Dar Global in partnership with The Trump Organization, bringing together unmatched expertise in luxury real estate.
  • World’s Highest Outdoor Pool: Swim in the sky with a pool that overlooks Dubai’s glittering skyline.
  • Unmatched Location: Situated on Sheikh Zayed Road in Downtown Dubai, minutes from Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, and DIFC.

location_tile.title: Breathtaking Views, Inconic Address!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai rises in the heart of Dubai’s most dynamic corridor—Sheikh Zayed Road, the city’s main artery of commerce, culture, and connectivity. Whether commuting to work or enjoying the city’s premier destinations, residents will find themselves just moments from elite business hubs, five-star dining, and high-end shopping.

With the tower nestled between Downtown Dubai and the coast, the location delivers the ultimate blend of urban energy and coastal calm, making it a rare gem for discerning investors and world-class residents alike.

  • 2 minutes to DIFC
  • 4 minutes to Burj Khalifa
  • 5 minutes to Dubai Mall
  • 7 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 8 minutes to Jumeirah Beach
  • 10 minutes to City Walk
  • 12 minutes to Dubai International Airport (DXB)
  • 15 minutes to Dubai Marina

seo.metaTitle: Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai by Dar Global
seo.metaDescription: Trump Tower Dubai by Dar Al Arkan delivers world-class residences, setting a new benchmark for elegance in the city's iconic skyline.

more_info.answer: The tower will feature a selection of 2-bedroom, 3-bedroom, and 4-bedroom penthouse residences, all designed to offer luxury living with panoramic views.
more_info.question: What types of units will be available in the development?

more_info.answer: Yes, the project will encompass a Trump-branded hotel, providing world-class hospitality services alongside the residential units.
more_info.question: Will the development include hotel facilities?

more_info.answer: The development is a collaboration between Dar Global, the international arm of Saudi Arabia's Dar Al Arkan Real Estate Development Company, and The Trump Organization. ​
more_info.question: Who is the developer behind Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai?

more_info.answer: Trump Tower Dubai is scheduled for completion in December 2031.
